document_frames.gsf_evidence: No single project GSF is printed. 'Overall Summary Simple' column F gives a separate SF per site option (F11=74,317; F13=51,740; F15=44,767; ... F39=17,670), each drawn from its own detail sheet. Section area sheets ('Section 1 Areas'!H24 TOTAL GROSS FLOOR AREA) are zero/unused. Project record carries no gross area.
document_frames.coding_evidence: 'Section Setup'!A2-F30 defines DCW's own elemental groups (Level 1: '1 Shell', '2 Interiors', '3 Equipment & Vertical Transportation', '4 Mechanical & Electrical'; Level 2: '01 Foundations' ... '13 Fire Protection'), and the sitework/section sheets use in-house site categories ('Site Preparation & Demolition', 'Site Improvements', 'Site Utilities' - Sum1!C10:C12). 'Fill this out first...'!C20 'CSI Coding (Drop Down)' = 'No', and the section sheets show C6 =IF(CSI="Yes","CSI","") resolving blank. The hidden 'MASTERFORMAT 2012' sheet is only an unused lookup table.
document_frames.markup_evidence: Detail sheets price bare quantity x rate (e.g. '1'!K=$H*$J; Sum1!H16 'SITE CONSTRUCTION' = direct cost only). Markups are added below on each Sum sheet: Sum1!H18 {=H16*E18}, then each following line is applied to the running subtotal, e.g. Sum1!H19 {=$E19*SUM(H$16:H18)}, H20 {=$E20*SUM(H$16:H19)} ... H26 {=$E26*SUM(H$16:H25)} - i.e. cascading/compound, not summed on a common base. Rates set globally at 'Fill this out first...' Q4=0.07, S4=0.068, T4=0.0175, V4=0.0057, X4=0.015, Y4=0.04, J5=0.15 (Design Contingency), L5=0.045 (Construction Contingency). The escalation line Sum1!E29 is 0% ('Escalation to Start Date - Q1 2028'). Note the Interpretive Design/Build Allowance is section-specific (Sum1!E26=0.5%, Sum2!E26=2%, Sum3!E26=4%, Sum4/Sum5!E26=2%).
document_frames.base_date_evidence: 'Fill this out first...'!F36 'Escalation Base Date' with G36 = 'April 16th, 2024' {=Date}; report date 'Fill this out first...'!C17 = 'April 16th, 2024'; page headers read 'Project Prioritization Plan     April 16th, 2024'. Escalation to construction start (Sum1!D29 'Escalation to Start Date - Q1 2028') is carried at 0%, so prices stand at the base date. Note this differs from the recorded issue date of 2024-04-05.
document_frames.stated_total_evidence: 'Overall Summary Simple'!B9 'Site Options', H9 = 208,035,696.90 {=H11+H15+H17+H19+H21+H25+H27+H31+H37} - the only project-level figure printed on the summary. Caution: the formula picks up only 9 of the 15 listed site options (H13, H23, H29, H33, H35, H39 are omitted). The lower 'RECOMMENDED BUDGET' cell (H111) is broken by #REF! precedents and shows no usable value. Alternates (H43:H49) are listed separately and are not in H9.
document_frames.deliverable_type_evidence: Title Page C35-C40: 'Prepared by: Andrew Jonsson, DCW Cost Management' for client CLR Design ('Fill this out first...'!C25-C26); 'Fill this out first...'!C14 Estimate Stage = 'Project Prioritization Plan'. Sheets 1-15/Sum1-Sum15 carry DCW's own quantity x rate build-up (e.g. Sum1!H10 ='1'!K54, '1' sheet lines with Quantity/Unit/Rate/Total). No columns comparing or critiquing another party's numbers, so not an estimate_review or reconciliation.

document_frames.gsf_evidence: 'Section 1'!E8 = 19898 with F8 'Total GSF' (Level One 9,976 + Level Two 9,922); carried to 'Section 1 Sum'!B9 and 'Overall Sum Simple'!E19 (=Section_1_GFA) where the building $/SF of 625.79 is computed. Sitework is priced against a separate site area of 30,330 SF ('Sitework 1 Sum'!B9, 'Overall Sum Simple'!E23). document_frames.coding_evidence: 'Section Setup'!B3:F36 defines A Substructure … G90 Other Site Construction; 'Section 1 Sum'!B10:B31 uses A10/A20/B10/B20/B30/C10…F20; detail lines coded to Level 3 e.g. 'Section 1'!C45 'A1010 Standard Foundations'. document_frames.base_date_evidence: FTOF!G28 'Escalation Base Date' = 2025-07-28 (formula =Date), with FTOF!G26/H26 'Escalate to' = 'Start Date' and annual rates at FTOF!H31:H37. The escalation to the April 2026 construction start is a separate markup line ('Section 1 Sum'!C51 'Escalation to Start Date (Apr 2026)', 3.0157%), not the base. document_frames.deliverable_type_evidence: FTOF!D37-D38 'Estimate Stage' = '100% SD', 'Estimate Type' = 'Cost Plan'; covers read '100% SD Cost Plan  July 28, 2025' ('Cover (Landscape)'!C7, 'Title Page'!C1). reader_questions.prompt: This campus plan prices 15 separate site options with their own areas and no single project GSF - should gross area be left blank and areas captured per option instead? — confirm?
reader_questions.evidence: 'Overall Summary Simple' F11:F39 give per-option SF (74,317 / 51,740 / 44,767 / 45,730 / 61,689 / 52,762 / 51,631 / 114,929 / 56,345 / 139,667 / 95,936 / 54,560 / 51,838 / 18,605 / 17,670); no cover-sheet or summary-block total GSF; project record has none.

proposed_answer.text: Leave project gross area blank; carry per-option SF

reader_questions.prompt: The only printed project total, 'Site Options' = $208,035,696.90, sums just 9 of the 15 option lines - should this be recorded as the project total, or should the library hold the 15 option totals separately? — confirm?
reader_questions.evidence: 'Overall Summary Simple'!H9 {=H11+H15+H17+H19+H21+H25+H27+H31+H37}; H13, H23, H29, H33, H35, H39 are excluded. 'RECOMMENDED BUDGET' at H111 is broken by #REF!.

proposed_answer.text: Record 208,035,696.90 as printed, flagged as a partial sum

reader_questions.prompt: Document is dated April 16th, 2024 (report date and escalation base date), while the upload record shows an issue date of 2024-04-05 - use 2024-04-16 as the pricing base date? — confirm?
reader_questions.evidence: 'Fill this out first...'!C17 Report Date and G36 Escalation Base Date both 'April 16th, 2024'; all sheet headers print the same date.

proposed_answer.text: Yes, base date 2024-04-16 as stated in the workbook

reader_questions.prompt: Estimate stage is recorded in the workbook as 'Project Prioritization Plan' (a campus-wide capital planning exercise) - record phase as that rather than a design stage? — confirm?
reader_questions.evidence: 'Fill this out first...'!C14 = 'Project Prioritization Plan'; C18 Previous Stage = 'None'; Scope!C14 lists basis documents '2023-10 Estimating Plan Update 2' and '2023-11-06 ORZ Campus Plan_DRAFT'.

reader_questions.prompt: Record the project gross area as the 19,898 SF building GSF (sitework is priced separately against 30,330 SF of site area) — confirm?
reader_questions.evidence: 'Section 1'!E8 = 19898 'Total GSF'; 'Sitework 1 Sum'!B9 = 30330; 'Cost Sum By Bldg'!E9 = 39,796 only because unbuilt Alternate 1 repeats the same 19,898 SF.

proposed_answer.text: 19,898 GSF building; 30,330 SF site area held separately

reader_questions.prompt: Treat the 3.0157% 'Escalation to Start Date (Apr 2026)' as a markup on top of a 28 July 2025 price base, rather than as the pricing base date — confirm?
reader_questions.evidence: FTOF!H28 Escalation Base Date = 2025-07-28; 'Section 1 Sum'!C51/D51/G51 escalation line applied after all other markups.

proposed_answer.text: Base date 2025-07-28; escalation is a markup

reader_questions.prompt: Ignore the secondary 'APRIL 2026' summary block that multiplies section totals by a written factor 1.0415 ('Overall Sum Simple'!G29 = G19*1.0415, G42 = G23*1.0415) since its grand total cell G44 is broken by a #REF! — confirm the headline total is G25 = $15,516,944?
reader_questions.evidence: 'Overall Sum Simple'!G29, G42 use a hard-written 1.0415 factor; G30 = #REF!*1.0415 and G44 = Sim_Sum_Sitework25[Total]+G30+G29 both error.

proposed_answer.text: Yes, use G25 = 15,516,944; disregard the 1.0415 block

reader_questions.prompt: Phase should be recorded as 100% SD (Schematic Design) cost plan — confirm?
reader_questions.evidence: FTOF!D37 'Estimate Stage' = '100% SD'; cover/title headers read '100% SD Cost Plan July 28, 2025'.
